format: Delta Reign (DLR): cards not already in the pool (the ones shown so far). H and later = Standard; G = Expanded. Legendary Pyroduct and Legendary Summit are Legendary Stadiums: two halves played from the hand together as 1 Stadium card.

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 160 more damage.

attacks.name: Quadruple Hold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Magical Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Eager Fang
attacks.text: If your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Energetic Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Rewarm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Basic Fire Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Strong Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Ocean Gain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Voltaic Hammer
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Basic Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder-Clad
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Restricted Activation
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't use attacks unless you have 10 or more cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Goliath's Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Brutal Lands
attacks.text: If a Stadium that has "Legendary" in its name is in play, this attack does 170 more damage.

abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gaia Crush
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Psychic Marionette
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Eerie Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Energizing Present
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Energy card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Colorful Whip
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Pokémon from your hand, and this attack does 30 damage for each different type of Pokémon you revealed in this way.

abilities.name: Ruler's Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Storm Emerald
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Fire Energy and each Lightning Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. (Your ruling: an Energy that provides every type, 1 at a time, counts once.)

abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Dive
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Aarune
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Supporter and Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Adventure Lantern
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and a Basic Lightning Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Grisham
cards.text: Heal 50 damage from each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.name: Legendary Pyroduct
cards.text: Evolution Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Pyroduct from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Legendary Pyroduct
cards.text: Evolution Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Pyroduct from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Legendary Summit
cards.text: Whenever a Colorless Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from the opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Summit from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Legendary Summit
cards.text: Whenever a Colorless Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from the opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Summit from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Legendary Abyss
cards.text: Each time a Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) is healed, double the amount of damage healed. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Abyss from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Legendary Abyss
cards.text: Each time a Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) is healed, double the amount of damage healed. Legendary Stadium: you can't play this card by itself; play both halves of Legendary Abyss from your hand together as 1 Stadium card.

cards.name: Zinnia's Trust
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move an Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon.
